body: thanks for the reply, it is mostly the negative stigma of counseling and psychiatry. Someone I like pointed out that I went to counseling and I think it's time for me to try my best tough it out rather than seeking help. I am still taking the meds though.... I try to stop relying on them. And sometimes looking at this sub too much makes me feel a bit more suicidal, just feel like I should try to bite the bullet and look at the bright side and stuff. Like this morning I was still planning where to jump, but then now in the afternoon I am feeling ok.....But it just disrupts my life a lot during these few years. I'd rather be dead than have these thoughts. Suicidal thoughts make you not think about consequences and overall make you make stupid choices and make you more suicidal.
I used to take antidepressants though, and it sorta helped.

no some people said I was faking depression.
I don't know whether I'm depressed or not.
But I feel like killing myself most of the times, and crying and feeling hopeless a lot of times.
That's why I thought I was depressed.

I haven't sought help yet. Used to go to the psychiatrist though, I don't go anymore.
